title: Pillow's bundled OpenJPEG carries an unreleased heap-overflow fix
summary: Pillow: Bundled libopenjp2 2.5.4 in all wheels since 11.1.0 carries OSV-2025-219 heap-buffer-overflow write reachable from Image.open().load()
trigger: Image.open and load on a crafted JPEG 2000 file with a Pillow wheel from 11.1.0 onward, whose bundled libopenjp2 2.5.4 lacks the upstream fix for OSV-2025-219.
finding: A JPEG 2000 file is refused by name before Pillow sees it. A patched system OpenJPEG does not help a wheel that bundles its own, which is one more reason to refuse the format by name rather than trust the decoder's version.

protect.general: Upgrade Pillow to a version that has the fix; the upstream record names it.
protect.specific: Refuse JPEG 2000 by name, as sillybos does by default.

notes: Proposed from the advisory's text on 2026-11-01, as part of folding the backfill into the record; not yet confirmed by a person.
